trapSays.line: A man, maybe 20s heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🪤 A man, maybe 20s is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
🪤 A man, maybe 20s is back from the pit line. "Pit was quiet. They'll keep."
Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.

🪤 A man, maybe 20s catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Recipe: Pit Trap (Level 1). A pit with stakes in the bottom. Dig it on a trail, brush it over, wait.

🪤 A man, maybe 20s catches you watching the pit line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They walk you out to it — the depth, the sharpened stakes at the bottom, where the game trail runs. "Brush it over with leaves. And mark it well — your own pit will take you too." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
